 Accounting → Compliance → Billing → Collections → Cash Flow → MIS → Profitability → Financial Controls

 • Lead monthly books closure and ensure accurate accounting
 



 • Review bank, customer and vendor reconciliations
 



 • Control billing and prevent unbilled revenue

 • Review payroll inputs, deductions, advances and reimbursements
 



 • Prepare monthly P\&L, Balance Sheet summaries and Management MIS
 



 • Monitor budgets, overheads, direct costs and margin performance
 



 • Develop client\-wise, service\-wise and job\-wise profitability reporting
 



 • Strengthen maker\-checker controls and prevent financial leakage
 



 • Lead, allocate and review the work of the Accounts \& Finance team
 



  





 MANAGEMENT REPORTING
 



  





 The Finance Manager will provide clear visibility of:
 



  





 Booked → Executed → Invoiced → Collected

 • Cash position and forecast
 



 • Receivable and payable ageing
 



 • Gross profit and gross margin
 



 • EBITDA and PAT
 



 • Budget vs Actual
 



 • Client, service and job profitability
 



 • Financial risks and corrective actions
 



  





 KEY KRAs AND KPIs
 



  





 Financial Accuracy \& Compliance
 



  





 • Monthly books closure by the 7th working day
 



 • Accounting accuracy of at least 99%
 



 • 100% on\-time statutory compliance
 



  





 Cash Flow, Billing \& Collections
 



  





 • At least 95% of eligible executed revenue invoiced within three working days
 



 • At least 90% of due collections received within agreed credit terms
 



 • Immediate 30\-day cash\-flow forecast variance maintained within ±10%
 



  





 Profitability, MIS \& Financial Controls
 



  





 • Monthly Management MIS submitted by the 10th
 



 • At least 95% of material revenue mapped to identifiable direct costs
 



 • Zero material financial leakage resulting from control failure
 



  





 CANDIDATE PROFILE
 



  





 • 6–9 years of relevant Accounts \& Finance experience
 



 • Strong knowledge of GST, TDS, accounts receivable and accounts payable
 



 • Experience managing monthly closure and Balance Sheet schedules
 



 • Strong understanding of cash flow and working\-capital management
 



 • Experience preparing P\&L, MIS and Budget vs Actual reports
 



 • Strong Excel and financial\-analysis skills
 



 • Experience managing a small finance team
 



 • Strong follow\-up, ownership and problem\-solving ability
 



 • Comfortable working directly with the CEO and senior management
 



  





 PREFERRED BACKGROUND
 



  





 • B.Com or M.Com
 



 • CA Inter, CMA Inter or MBA Finance is desirable
 



 • Experience with Tally, Zoho Books or an equivalent accounting system
 



 • Experience in facility management, manpower, projects, contracting, hospitality services or another B2B service business
 



 • Exposure to job costing and project profitability

 We need a finance professional who can move beyond transaction processing and convert financial data into business insight.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should be able to:
 



  





 • Explain the key drivers behind financial performance
 



 • Provide reliable visibility of cash flow and working capital
 



 • Identify margin leakage and cost\-control opportunities
 



 • Anticipate financial risks before they affect operations
 



 • Recommend practical and commercially sound corrective actions
 



 • Establish financial accountability across departments
 



  





 This role will not suit candidates whose experience is limited to data entry, voucher posting, GST filing, payroll processing or operating Tally without financial analysis and management reporting.

**JOB PURPOSE** 




 To be the finance co\-pilot to the Fans and Consumer Lighting business — owning the business P\&L, driving profitable growth through disciplined investment decisions, portfolio and pricing management, innovation governance and marketing ROI, so that every rupee invested behind the portfolio creates long term value.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**1\.** 
**Business P\&L ownership** 



* Own the Fans and Consumer Lighting P\&L end to end — from gross sales to business contribution and business EBITDA.
* Act as the single finance point of accountability for the portfolio; co\-sign every commercial decision that moves the P\&L.
* Publish a monthly business performance review with drivers, risks and corrective actions — not just numbers.



**2\. Rolling forecasts \& AOP** 



* Build and maintain a rolling 12\-month forecast for volume, revenue, margin and A\&P at business and category level.
* Lead the Annual Operating Plan for Fans and Consumer Lighting — bottom\-up build by category, channel and SKU.
* Flag forecast\-to\-actual gaps early with a quantified bridge and a recovery plan agreed with the business.



**3\. Margin by SKU \& category P\&L** 



* Maintain SKU\-level gross margin, contribution and profitability rankings; refresh with every cost or price change.
* Build product category P\&Ls (Fans, Consumer Lighting, Lamps, Luminaires, Decorative and Functional Lighting, etc.) with fully allocated costs.
* Identify and drive margin\-accretive mix shifts; escalate loss\-making and sub\-threshold SKUs with an exit or fix plan.



**4\. Variance** 



* Deliver disciplined price–volume–mix–cost (PVM) bridges versus AOP, forecast and prior year at business and category level.
* Explain the business reason behind every variance — category mix, channel mix, promo intensity, input cost, operating leverage.
* Convert variance insight into named actions with owners and timelines; track closure to completion.



**5\.** 
**Pricing \& revenue growth management** 



* Partner on MOP/MRP architecture, price laddering and premiumization across the Fans and Consumer Lighting portfolio.
* Evaluate price elasticity, competitive positioning versus peers, and the price–pack architecture (PPA) opportunity.
* Govern trade schemes, discounts and gross\-to\-net leakage; quantify the ROI of every scheme before and after launch.



**6\. PPA \& premiumization** 



* Lead price–pack architecture work — identify white spaces, entry price points and premium tiers by channel.
* Model the margin and mix impact of PPA interventions and track realization against the approved business case.
* Support portfolio simplification and SKU rationalization to reduce complexity, working capital, and supply chain cost.



**7\. A\&P investment \& marketing ROI** 



* Own planning, tracking and governance of Fans and Consumer Lighting A\&P spend — media, digital, e\-commerce, activation and visibility.
* Measure ROI on media, consumer promotions and platform spends; recommend reallocation towards the highest\-return levers.
* Ensure spends follow the DOA process and stay within the approved plan; no unbudgeted commitments.



**8\.** 
**Innovation \& NPD finance** 



* Build and challenge business cases for new launches — costing, pricing, payback, breakeven volumes and cannibalization.
* Prioritize the innovation pipeline on the basis of value creation, not activity.
* Conduct post\-launch reviews at 6 and 12 months; report benefit realisation versus the approved case.



**9\. Channel \& customer profitability** 



* Track profitability by channel — general trade, modern trade, e\-commerce, quick commerce and alternate — and by key account.
* Quantify the true cost to serve, including placement fees, returns, damages and platform commissions.
* Support channel mix decisions that protect category margins while defending share.



**10\. Controls, working capital \& governance** 



* Ensure the integrity of business financials — provisions, rebates, claims, price protection and inventory valuation.
* Partner supply chain on inventory health, ageing, non\-moving stock and working capital release for the business.
* Uphold internal financial controls, the RACM and statutory/audit requirements within the business commercial processes.



  





**EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Chartered Accountant / MBA (Finance) from a reputed institute. CMA with strong commercial exposure will also be considered.



  





**WORK EXPERIENCE** 



* 6\-10 years post\-qualification, with at least 2 years in category or commercial finance in consumer durables, FMEG, electricals, fans, lighting, FMCG or appliances.



  





**PREFERRED/ ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENT** 



* Strong costing and margin analytics
* PVM bridging
* Price elasticity and scenario modelling
* Advanced Excel and financial modelling
* SAP (FI/CO, COPA), Power BI or equivalent visualization, planning tools such as Anaplan / TM1 / SAP BPC. Familiarity with e\-commerce and secondary sales data platforms is an advantage.

 10–15 Years

 MBA in Finance / CA / CFA / CS / LLB or equivalent postgraduate qualification
 



 ABOUT THE ORGANISATION
 



 A leading
 **RBI\-registered Asset Reconstruction Company (ARC)** 
 engaged in the acquisition and resolution of stressed assets from banks and financial institutions.
 



 The organisation focuses on structured and efficient resolution strategies, including restructuring, enforcement and asset monetisation, with an emphasis on value maximisation and timely recovery.
 



 ROLE OVERVIEW
 



 The
 **AVP – ARC Business – Execution** 
 will be responsible for managing the
 **end\-to\-end execution of stressed\-asset transactions and resolution initiatives** 
 .
 



 The role will involve transaction evaluation, financial analysis, due diligence, structuring, bidding, documentation, transaction closure, asset onboarding and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
 



 This is a
 **purely execution\-oriented role** 
 and does
 **not** 
 involve Business Development, Sales, Marketing, Origination or Asset Acquisition.

**1\. Transaction Evaluation \& Execution** 



* Evaluate stressed\-asset opportunities referred for execution.
* Analyse borrower exposures, outstanding debt, security, recovery prospects and available information.
* Coordinate financial, legal, technical and commercial due diligence.
* Review valuations, cash flows, security cover and potential resolution scenarios.
* Prepare transaction evaluation notes and management presentations.



**2\. Deal Structuring \& Bidding** 



* Support structuring of stressed\-asset transactions within applicable regulatory and internal frameworks.
* Coordinate preparation and submission of bids under Swiss Challenge, bilateral and competitive processes.
* Review transaction structures, pricing assumptions and financial models.

**3\. Transaction Closure \& Asset Onboarding** 



* Drive post\-bid execution and transaction closure activities.
* Coordinate documentation, conditions precedent and regulatory requirements.
* Work closely with Legal, Risk, Finance, Compliance and Resolution teams.
* Ensure smooth onboarding and transfer of assets following transaction closure.
* Track and resolve outstanding transaction\-related matters.



**4\. Resolution Execution Support** 



* Work closely with the Asset Resolution team in implementing approved resolution strategies.
* Support restructuring, enforcement, settlement and asset monetisation initiatives.
* Monitor resolution milestones, recovery actions and execution timelines.
* Provide periodic transaction and resolution updates to senior management.



**5\. Cross\-Functional Stakeholder Management** 



* Coordinate with internal teams and external legal, valuation, diligence and advisory professionals.
* Ensure timely exchange and validation of transaction information.
* Identify execution issues and coordinate their resolution.
* Escalate material transaction risks, delays and dependencies to senior management.



**6\. MIS, Governance \& Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to applicable RBI guidelines, regulatory requirements and internal policies.

* Identify opportunities to improve transaction execution processes.



 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

* Transaction evaluation quality and accuracy.

* Bidding\-process efficiency.
* Successful asset onboarding following transaction closure.
* Timely implementation of approved resolution strategies.

 **transaction execution, stressed\-asset resolution or distressed\-debt processes** 
 .

 REQUIRED SKILLS \& COMPETENCIES

 .

 \- Treasury. Cash flow forecasting across special purpose vehicles, drawdown scheduling against construction progress, surplus deployment, banking relationships and mandates, interest rate and currency exposure, and the controls that keep all of it clean.
 



 \- The credit story. Rating agency engagement with CRISIL, ICRA and CARE, the information memorandum, the lender pack, and the quarterly reporting that keeps a lender comfortable between drawdowns.

A Fortune 200 enterprise is scaling its Global Capability Centre in India, and its record\-to\-report pod has partnered with Flexiple to hire a Financial Reporting Analyst who will own a slice of the monthly and quarterly close for one of its regional business units.
 



**Where this sits in the centre** 




 The centre's finance function has moved past pure transaction processing and is now expected to produce reporting packs that regional CFOs actually read. This analyst joins a pod of six, reporting into a Reporting Manager, and will be one of the first hires trusted to question a variance rather than simply restate it.
 



**What lands on your desk each month** 



* Prepare and review journal entries, accruals and balance sheet reconciliations for two to three assigned entities ahead of monthly close
* Draft management reporting packs, flagging variances against budget and prior period with a first\-pass explanation before the review call
* Support statutory and group reporting deliverables, including audit schedules and the walkthroughs external auditors ask for
* Maintain reconciliation trackers and chase open items with regional finance teams before they age past 30 days
* Feed into the centre's ongoing effort to standardise reporting templates across entities acquired at different times



**What we need from day one** 




 1 to 5 years in financial reporting, general ledger accounting or audit, ideally with some exposure to a multi\-entity or shared\-services environment. Excel fluency at a formula\-and\-pivot level is assumed; prior exposure to an ERP such as SAP or Oracle, and to a consolidation tool such as HFM or OneStream, is a genuine advantage. You should be someone who reads a trial balance for what it is telling you, not just for what it says on the page.
 



**Where you would be based** 




 Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai or Remote (India).
 



**How the process runs** 




 An initial HR conversation is followed by a short reporting assignment, a working round with the Reporting Manager, and a closing conversation on fit with the wider finance team.
 



 One application from you is kept on file and considered against this opening and any other reporting roles that open up across our client base.

**About the company:** 




 BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. Its a leading service provider for the mid\-markets with client service at its heart.
 



  





 BDO India Services Private Limited (or BDO India) is the India member firm of BDO International. BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory \& assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries. BDO India is led by more than 300\+ Partners \& Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3\-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi\-fold.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced Financial Reporting Manager to take ownership of the financial reporting and month\-end close process across group entities. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role requiring strong technical accounting expertise, audit management capabilities, and a strong focus on internal controls and financial governance.
 



  





 The role will work closely with Service Lines, FP\&A, Tax, Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Compliance, and senior leadership to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



  





**Financial Reporting \& Month\-End Close** 



* Own and drive the monthly financial reporting and close process across group entities.
* Ensure timely and accurate closure of monthly books within defined timelines.
* Review trial balances, general ledger accounts, and supporting schedules.
* Review and ensure accurate accounting of provisions, accruals, prepayments, depreciation, amortization, and other month\-end entries.
* Perform detailed variance analysis of actuals versus budget, forecast, and prior periods, and highlight key business drivers to management.
* Ensure completeness and accuracy of financial data across entities.



  





**Financial Statements \& Accounting Compliance** 



* Prepare and review annual financial statements in accordance with applicable accounting standards, including Ind AS / Local GAAP.
* Ensure appropriate accounting treatment for complex transactions and financial reporting matters.
* Provide accurate financial information, schedules, and supporting documentation for regulatory and statutory filings.
* Partner with the Compliance and Secretarial teams to ensure timely and accurate regulatory reporting.



  





**Statutory \& Internal Audit Management** 



* Lead and manage statutory audits across group entities.
* Coordinate and support internal audits, including preparation of audit schedules, reconciliations, supporting documents, and deliverables.
* Act as the key point of contact between auditors and internal stakeholders.
* Manage audit timelines and ensure timely closure of audit observations and queries.
* Proactively identify and resolve audit issues with minimal escalation.



  





**Internal Financial Controls \& Governance** 



* Execute and monitor Internal Financial Controls over Financial Reporting (IFCR/IFC) within the reporting function.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and testing of key financial controls.
* Identify control gaps and drive timely remediation.
* Strengthen financial governance and control frameworks across entities.
* Ensure compliance with internal policies, accounting standards, and reporting requirements.



  





**Lease Accounting \& Fixed Assets** 



* Manage lease accounting, including maintenance of lease trackers and periodic accounting entries.
* Ensure appropriate accounting and reporting under Ind AS 116, where applicable.
* Oversee fixed asset accounting, including capitalization, depreciation, disposals, and reconciliation.
* Ensure accuracy and completeness of fixed asset registers and related schedules.



  





**Balance Sheet \& Month\-End Governance** 



* Ensure all balance sheet schedules are prepared, reviewed, and reconciled on a monthly basis.
* Maintain strong controls over provisions and expense recognition.
* Ensure appropriate cut\-off procedures and completeness of expense recognition.
* Investigate and resolve long\-outstanding reconciling items and unusual balances.
* Drive high standards of accuracy and financial discipline across the reporting process.



  





**Stakeholder Management** 



* Collaborate closely with Service Lines, FP\&A, AP, AR, Tax, Treasury, Compliance, and other cross\-functional teams.
* Provide management with relevant financial information, analysis, and insights.
* Partner with stakeholders to resolve accounting, reporting, and close\-related issues.
* Build strong working relationships with senior stakeholders and external auditors.



  





**Process Improvement \& Systems** 



* Identify opportunities to improve and standardize financial reporting and close processes.
* Drive standardization of reconciliations, reporting schedules, and management reporting formats.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen controls and improve process efficiency.
* Support enhanced utilization and optimization of ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, or Oracle.
* Drive process improvements, automation, and reporting efficiencies wherever relevant.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Chartered Accountant (CA) Mandatory.
* 2\-5 years of post\-qualification experience in financial reporting, accounting, controllership, or related finance functions.
* Strong hands\-on experience in:
* Financial reporting and financial statements
* Month\-end and year\-end close
* Statutory and internal audits
* Balance sheet reconciliations
* Internal financial controls
* Technical accounting
* Experience managing reporting across multiple entities will be preferred.
* Experience in professional services, consulting, Big 4, or similar environments will be an advantage.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, or Oracle.

title: Analyst — FP&A
description:
Analyst — FP\&A \| Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited \| Mumbai Metropolitan Region
 



  
 



 Build and hold the models a real assets platform forecasts on — development appraisals, project cash flows, rent rolls, debt schedules — and learn from the Financial Controller how a number becomes a decision. Modelling as a craft, not a skill.
 



  
 



 A note before you read on. The team structure, reporting lines, direct reports, seat titles and hiring entity described in this brief reflect the platform's current plan and may change as the platform builds out. Compensation and incentive structures are confirmed in the offer, not here.
 



  
 



 REPORTS TO: Financial Controller — Head of FP\&A \& Asset Management · EXPERIENCE: 2–5 years in financial modelling, FP\&A or transaction analysis, in or around real estate
 



  
 



 ABOUT VANTROCK
 



 Vantrock is India's independent, operator\-led real assets platform — real assets only — with logistics and industrial as the first phase of its growth.
 



 Founded by Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO, who has built three institutional platforms from zero and is building the fourth on his own capital: 52 million sq ft delivered (32 million as developer, 20 million as contractor), 2,000\+ acres acquired, 200\+ buildings, two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close, India's first domestic warehousing AIF and India's largest industrial real estate exit — delivered across the founder's three prior platforms.
 



  
 



 THE FINANCE \& ACCOUNTS TEAM
 



 Vantrock keeps its books in\-house. The finance function owns every number from the site to the board.
 



 Twenty\-one seats when fully built; sixteen live now, one of them already filled. Small enough that every person in it is known by name to the founder; large enough to run a platform properly. Every seat in the team is a builder's seat: the function does not exist yet in the form described here, and the people who join it now are the ones who will decide what it becomes.
 



  
 



 THE MODEL IS THE TOOL; THE FORECAST IS THE PRODUCT
 



 Vantrock separates the two things a finance function does with a number. The accounts team records what happened. The FP\&A and Asset Management team — the Financial Controller and this seat — says what will happen and raises a hand early when the two drift apart. Every asset against the underwriting it was bought on. Every construction budget against its bill of quantities. Every lease against the rent roll it was modelled at. Every procurement decision priced before it is made.
 



  
 



 WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS
 



 The Financial Controller's seat is forecasting, red\-flagging and the Asset Review — and it cannot be done alone. The models have to be built, refreshed, reconciled to the books and stress\-tested every month, for a pipeline of 10 million sq ft across four cities and a set of strategies queued behind the first. This seat does that work, and is the seat from which the platform intends to grow the next Financial Controller.
 



  
 



 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



 1\. The models. Development appraisals, project cash flows, lease\-up and rent\-roll models, debt schedules, exit models — built to the platform's standard, documented, version\-controlled, and reconciled to the ledger every month.
 



 2\. The rolling forecast, mechanics. The monthly refresh for the platform and every project entity — actuals pulled from the books, assumptions updated with the project, leasing and procurement teams, variances computed and listed for the Financial Controller's review.
 



 3\. The Asset Review pack, first draft. Every asset's page — actuals against underwriting, cost against budget, the triggers — assembled from the dashboards and the models for the Financial Controller to finish and present.
 



 4\. Variance analysis. Every material variance traced to its cause and written up in two lines before it reaches the Financial Controller — not discovered in the meeting.
 



 5\. The founder's question. The ad\-hoc analysis — what does this lease do to the exit, what does this contractor's variation do to cost\-to\-complete — turned around the same day, correctly.
 



 6\. The operating layer. Models and trackers live on the platform's dashboards, not in a private spreadsheet.
 



  
 



 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



 ESSENTIAL
 



 – 2–5 years in financial modelling, FP\&A or transaction analysis, at a real estate developer, an investor, a lender's real estate team, a consultancy serving real estate, or a fund.
 



 – Modelling as a craft. You have built a development appraisal or a project cash\-flow model from a blank sheet — not modified a template — and you can explain every assumption in it. This will be tested in a case.
 



 – Accounting literacy: you can read a trial balance, tie a model to a ledger and know why the two disagree.
 



 – Excel at an expert level, and fluency with at least one of the modern tools around it — Python, SQL, a BI layer, or the platform's own dashboards.
 



 – Precise, fast and honest about uncertainty. You say "I don't know" before you guess.
 



 – A Chartered Accountant, or an MBA in Finance. Either. An MBA from a second\-tier institution with three years of the right modelling outranks a first\-tier degree with none.
 



 – Based in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, or relocating before joining.
 



 WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT
 



 – Not an investment\-banking analyst seat. The models here are held for years and reconciled monthly; they are not built for a pitch and forgotten.
 



 – Not a reporting seat. You build and analyse; the dashboards report.
 



 – Not a seat for someone who wants to be told what to model. The Financial Controller will set the question; finding the right model is your job.
 



  
 



 HOW YOU WILL WORK
 



 – The books are in\-house. You reconcile your models to a ledger kept twenty feet away, every month.
 



 – Everything runs on the platform's dashboards. No private spreadsheets; every model has a home, a version and an owner.
 



 – Judgment is written down. Every assumption has a source; every variance has a two\-line cause.
 



 – Mumbai Metropolitan Region, full\-time, in person, with occasional site visits.
 



  
 



 COMPENSATION
 



 Vantrock benchmarks compensation against the upper quartile for the role and market, weighted toward equity for candidates who want to build with us long\-term. We discuss specific numbers in the first conversation rather than anchoring either side prematurely.
 



 Wealth creation is part of the engine, not only the salary: a performance\-linked annual bonus, and a path to ESOP\-linked incentives as the seat grows — priced to the seat and confirmed in the offer.
 



  
 



 CULTURAL FIT
 



 We're building Vantrock over a decade, not a funding cycle. We're looking for people who treat technology as the default answer rather than a supplement, who want to be co\-builders of the platform rather than employees executing instructions, and who are comfortable saying "I don't know" and "I was wrong." If you want a defined role with defined edges, this isn't the right seat. If you want to help build an institution from zero, it might be.
 



 AI proficiency is a standing requirement in every Vantrock seat. You work fluently with AI tools for research, modelling, drafting and analysis, and you build on the platform's dashboards rather than around them. A supervised AI Proficiency Test is part of the process for every seat, at every level of seniority, and we say so openly.
 



 Partner command is the second standing requirement. The books are ours, but auditors, banks, the fund administrator, valuers, law firms and system vendors are commanded by this team — briefed, held to a standard, integrated — never deferred to. We hire for judgment and accountability.
 



  
 



 HOW WE WILL ASSESS
 



 Everyone who applies hears from us within two working days. It carries two links: a fixed set of six questions answered by AI interview — about forty minutes, and the first work sample; we review it before the CV — and the Vantrock AI Proficiency Test, which every hire takes at every level. From there:
 



 1\. The Model conversation. The best model you have built from a blank sheet: what it decided, what it got wrong, what you would change. With the Financial Controller.
 



 2\. A 90\-minute supervised case. A data pack for a warehousing development — land, approvals timeline, construction budget, a pre\-lease term sheet, a facility term sheet — from which you build the project cash flow, compute three headline outputs, and state the three assumptions you are least sure of. Reviewed with the Financial Controller and the CFO — or the Founder \& CEO until the CFO is in seat.
 



 3\. References. One or two former reporting managers, contacted directly.
 



 Once we have received your application, your AI interview and your test, we will reach out with next steps. Your application is confidential: it is seen only by the Founder's Office and the hiring lead, and nothing is shared with your current employer or referenced without your consent.
 



  
 



 TO APPLY
 



 Write to careers@vantrock.com with the subject line "Analyst — FP\&A — \[your name]", and attach:
 



 – Your CV. This is mandatory — a LinkedIn profile alone is not an application; we will read your LinkedIn as well.
 



 – One model you built from a blank sheet — anonymised as needed — with three sentences on what was hard about it. A screenshot is not a model; send the file or a link to it.
 



 – Your notice period and what you would need to see to move.
 



 – One short paragraph: the assumption in a development appraisal that most often turns out wrong, and how you would build the model so that being wrong about it is visible early. That paragraph matters more than the CV.
 



 We read everything that arrives with a model and a paragraph — properly, not skimmed. If this sounds like your seat, write to us.
 



  
 



 We don't hire roles. We build the platform. · Ownership, not employment. · Builders hire builders.
 




 Founder \& CEO, Vantrock
